title: Tyres
notes: Tyre labelling (2020/740) is in force, but the ESPR tyre DPP obligation is anticipated ~2028-2029. Treated as provisional until the DPP act is adopted. retentionYears is assumed, not sourced: ESPR Art. 9(2)(i) sets no figure — it requires availability for at least the expected lifetime of the product, delegated per product group, and no tyre delegated act has been adopted.
